item.title: One habit help purify my soul
item.description: morning walking after Sunrise connect with nature I love to walk in nature; it feels like a form of meditation to me. it is hard to find nature as i am Living in the city. so I prefer to walk just after sunrise. at 5 am, the streets and parks offer a quiet and peaceful atmosphere —it feels just like walking in nature. item.title: How to Get Up Early
item.description: https://www.youtube.com/@mayaleex3/featured how to get up early enjoy it The key to getting up early—and making it a sustainable habit—is to genuinely enjoy the experience. When waking up early feels rewarding rather than a chore, it becomes much easier to stick with it. as a mum, early moring is my own free time. Why Enjoyment Is the Key Intrinsic Motivation: When you look forward to something in the morning, you’re naturally more motivated to get up. Enjoyment turns discipline into desire. Positive Associations: If mornings are filled with activities you love, your brain starts to associate waking up early with pleasure rather than deprivation. item.title: Start Youtube Channel as Nonnative Speaker
Start Youtube at 40
item.description: Why I Started a YouTube Channel at 40 Have you ever thought about starting a YouTube channel, only to be held back by that voice in your head saying: “I’m not good enough.” “I’m not attractive enough.” “I can’t do it.” “It’s too hard.” “No one will watch.” “It’s too late.” That’s exactly what I told myself six years ago—and as a result, I gave up before I even started. Instead, I spent the last six years writing blogs because it felt safer, easier, and less intimidating. But now, as I approach 40, I’ve decided to finally give YouTube a real shot. In this video, I’ll share two reasons why I made this decision. Hopefully, my journey will inspire you to take action
